gen-gf-prosto-one-fs-paquito: Tall, wide-striding letters with a faint crayon-on-rough-paper wobble give the top line real character. Prosto One handles the swagger, while Paquito, confident and approachable, keeps caps close to lowercase height, pleasant in bite-sized helpings.
gen-gf-shadows-into-light-two-fs-bespoke: Shadows Into Light Two scrawls graceful, friendly curves that open outward. Casual charm lives up top, while Bespoke Sans, sharp and refined, handles a few lines with generous space at its curve ends.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-suwannaphum: Wide-mouthed lettering, Shantell Sans keeps one nib width throughout, while Suwannaphum stands tall with an open c. Long passages would read dignified and editorial, with a tall lowercase.
gen-gf-simonetta-fs-rowan: Simonetta comes in bold and commanding, with snug letter pairs and wide-set curve ends. Rowan opens every curve generously, literary and friendly, though it is not meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-epunda-slab: Sniglet sets a level, quiet beat with terminals that stop short of curling back in. And Epunda Slab, with its gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, would read dignified and classic over many pages.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-hanuman: Hanuman reads traditional and refined, its high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals giving paragraphs a gracious, upright posture. Sniglet, quiet and level up top, hands the conversation to Hanuman.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-bhutuka-expanded: Expressive and stencil-cut, Snowburst One bridges its tall letters widely, while BhuTuka Expanded One slows reading to a stroll. The stout, unclamped curves of the body are the real draw.
gen-gf-sofia-fs-plein: Sofia writes in a relaxed, friendly hand, its w drawn with no thick or thin strokes. Plein gives each round letter a clear channel, reliable and clean, and makes gentle company in passing.
gen-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-fs-erode: Erode brings a tall middle band and gentle stroke modulation, editorial and dignified. Swanky and Moo Moo is the relaxed, marker-traced voice, while Erode does the steadier work, best kept from long paragraphs.
gen-gf-swanky-and-moo-moo-satoshi: Swanky and Moo Moo writes in a relaxed, inviting hand, every stroke from one fixed nib. And Satoshi, with an unsqueezed e and soaring x-height, would read approachable, built for quick visits rather than marathons.
